## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed routine photographic activity during October 2025. A total of 390 captures were recorded during the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other operational issues were noted in the available report.

The activity represents the clinic’s recorded imaging workload for the reporting period. Captures were submitted for subsequent image assessment and grading in line with the usual process.

## Image quality

There were 17 ungradable image sets. This produced an ungradable rate of 4.4 per cent. The rate indicates that most submitted images were suitable for assessment, although the ungradable images could not be used for a definitive grading outcome.

The ungradable cases should continue to be monitored through routine quality review, with attention to any recurring factors affecting image acquisition.

## Grading

Grading identified 108 referable results. These cases require the appropriate follow-up under established clinical pathways.

The median lag from photograph capture to completed grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during October 2025. Results should continue to be reviewed through routine activity and quality monitoring to support timely referral and follow-up.
